recipes.title: Grandma's pasticcio
recipes.description: The classic, beloved Greek pasticcio with fluffy béchamel and delicious minced meat.
ingredients: 2 1/2 cups grated cheese (Kasseri, Kefalograviera or Graviera)
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan over high heat. Sauté the onion until soft, add the minced meat and fry it well.
Stir in the passata, tomato paste, sugar, parsley, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer until the liquid evaporates.
Remove the ground beef from the heat, let it cool slightly, and stir in 1 beaten egg and 1/2 cup of the grated cheese.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water with 1 tbsp. oil. Drain, rinse lightly with cold water and mix with 1/4 cup butter and 2 cups grated cheese.
Σε μια μικρή κατσαρόλα, αφήστε το γάλα να πάρει βράση. Σε άλλη κατσαρόλα, λιώστε τις 8 κ.σ. βούτυρο, προσθέστε το αλεύρι και σοτάρετε για περίπου 5 λεπτά.
Pour the hot milk all at once into the flour, beating vigorously with the whisk. Stir over low heat until thickened.
Remove the cream from the heat, season with salt, pepper, nutmeg and incorporate 4 lightly beaten eggs while mixing.
Butter a baking tray (30x40 cm) and sprinkle with breadcrumbs. Spread half the spaghetti, then the minced meat, then the rest of the spaghetti.
Pour the béchamel over the entire surface and bake at 180°C for about 1 hour. Let it rest for 20 minutes before serving.

memory.story: The favorite Sunday food that gathers the whole family around the table! The smell of béchamel lingers in the house until the afternoon.
